items.title: Monster Dirt Ride
items.description: Substitute a person and their vehicle with a custom character and a high-performance motorcycle while maintaining original movement and physics.

variants.prompt:
Replace the main person in <<<video_1>>> with the character from <<<image_1>>>, and replace the original vehicle they use with the vehicle from <<<image_2>>>. Apply both replacements throughout the entire video, including wide shots, close-ups, and reflections.

Character. Use <<<image_1>>> as the sole reference for the character’s face, hair, build, and clothing. Match the original person’s performance frame by frame, including actions, gestures, posture, facial movements, gaze, and timing. When the character interacts with the vehicle, keep their hands, feet, and body naturally aligned with the replacement vehicle’s controls and contact points.

Vehicle. Use <<<image_2>>> as the sole reference for the vehicle’s shape, proportions, colors, materials, wheels, and distinctive details. Match the original vehicle’s position, direction, speed, and maneuvers at the same moments in each shot. Keep wheel rotation, ground contact, shadows, reflections, and motion blur consistent with the movement and lighting in the source footage.

Text and graphics. Remove all visible text, captions, subtitles, logos, usernames, watermarks, social media branding, and graphic overlays, including any lettering or logos on the replacement character’s clothing or vehicle. Reconstruct the underlying surfaces naturally and keep their textures stable as the camera moves.

Scene continuity. Preserve the original background, lighting, camera movement, framing, cuts, timing, audio, other people, and surrounding objects. Keep the 16:9 frame. Keep the character’s identity, outfit, and vehicle design consistent across frames and cuts. Avoid morphing, flickering, identity drift, costume changes, warped vehicle parts, and unintended edits.

items.title: Frozen Lake Figure
items.description: Transform an original skater into a specific character who performs an elegant figure skating routine across a reflective ice surface.

variants.prompt:
원본 영상에서 줄무늬 스웨터를 입은 스케이터 한 명을 <<<image_1>>>의 남자로 교체해줘. 검은 바가지머리와 굵은 콧수염, 무표정한 얼굴, 검은 롱코트와 바지, 겨자색 셔츠, 초록 나비넥타이를 유지해줘. 신발은 은색 날이 달린 검은 피겨스케이트로 바꿔줘.

한 발로 활주하며 반대쪽 다리를 뻗는 동작부터 팔을 머리 위로 올려 도는 스핀과 마지막 포즈까지, 원본의 순서와 타이밍을 그대로 따라가줘. 코트 자락은 회전에 맞춰 자연스럽게 퍼지고, 거울 같은 얼음에 비친 모습도 같은 남자의 옷차림과 동작에 정확히 맞춰줘.

원본의 산과 숲, 햇빛, 카메라 움직임과 오디오를 유지해줘. 세로 9:16으로 구성하고 스케이트 날과 얼음 위 반사가 잘 보이게 해줘. 기존 워터마크를 제거하고 새 워터마크는 넣지 마.

items.title: Synchronized Crowd Bow
items.description: A central figure walks through a large organized group that performs a dramatic, synchronized deep bow in unison.

variants.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference video as the exact motion, choreography, timing, composition, and camera reference.
MAIN CHARACTER:
Replace ONLY the single central main character with the person shown in Character Reference 1.
The central main character must exactly match Character Reference 1 throughout the entire video.
Preserve the exact facial identity, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, clothing, and overall appearance of Character Reference 1.
The central character must remain clearly distinguishable from all surrounding characters at all times.
SURROUNDING CHARACTERS:
Replace ALL surrounding background people with the characters shown in Character Reference 2.
Every surrounding person must consistently match Character Reference 2 in clothing, headwear, mask, colors, body proportions, and overall appearance.
Do NOT apply Character Reference 2 to the central main character.
Do NOT apply Character Reference 1 to any surrounding character.
ACTION AND CHOREOGRAPHY:
Reproduce the exact actions, body movements, choreography, poses, timing, rhythm, and synchronization from the original reference video.
The surrounding crowd must perform the same synchronized group movements and synchronized deep bowing actions shown in the reference video.
The central main character must perform only the movements of the original central character.
Do not invent new gestures, movements, interactions, or choreography.
IDENTITY LOCK:
Keep the identity of the central character completely consistent from the first frame to the final frame.
Do not change, morph, merge, distort, duplicate, or swap the central character's face.
Do not replace the central character with any background character.
Keep all background characters visually consistent throughout the entire sequence.
CROWD CONSISTENCY:
Preserve the original number, placement, spacing, formation, depth, and relative positions of the surrounding people.
Do not add or remove people.
Do not randomly move people between positions.
Do not merge bodies or duplicate characters.
MOTION LOCK:
Strictly preserve the original video's motion.
Preserve the exact body movements, movement direction, choreography, synchronization, pacing, rhythm, and action timing.
CAMERA AND FRAMING:
Keep the original camera angle, camera movement, camera position, focal length, perspective, depth of field, framing, composition, shot scale, and shot duration unchanged.
Follow every original camera movement exactly.
Do not introduce any new camera movement.
Do not re-frame, crop, zoom, rotate, tilt, or alter the original composition unless that exact movement exists in the reference video.
SCENE:
Preserve the original spatial arrangement, crowd formation, foreground-background relationship, and scene geometry.
Maintain natural lighting, realistic shadows, realistic human anatomy, and photorealistic textures.
TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY:
Maintain strong frame-to-frame consistency.
No flickering.
No face changes.
No clothing changes.
No disappearing characters.
No duplicated people.
No warped hands or limbs.
No sudden changes in body proportions.
FINAL REQUIREMENT:
The final video must follow the reference video's original motion, choreography, timing, crowd formation, camera work, and editing as closely as possible, while changing only the visual identities specified by Character Reference 1 and Character Reference 2.

원본 인물의 몸짓과 박자, 이동 경로를 그대로 따라가. 주변 사람과 야간 거리, 카메라 구도, 컷 전환, 오디오는 유지하고 거리의 조명이 얼굴에도 자연스럽게 비치게 해줘. 기존 워터마크는 제거하고 그 자리를 주변 배경과 자연스럽게 이어줘. 완성 영상에는 새 워터마크를 넣지 마.

items.title: Festive Puppy Trio
items.description: Transform original subjects into three distinct dogs in bowties performing a synchronized dance in front of a Christmas tree.

variants.prompt:
원본 영상에서 크리스마스트리 앞에 나란히 서서 춤추는 고양이 세 마리를 아래의 강아지 세 마리로 교체한다. 세로 9:16 고정. 원본의 영상 길이, 오디오, 트리 조명, 거실 배경, 카메라 구도와 안무 타이밍을 유지한다.

화면 왼쪽은 <<<image_1>>>의 순백색 꼬똥 드 툴레아. 보송한 흰 털과 늘어진 귀, 빨간 벨벳 나비넥타이를 그대로 살린다.
가운데 주인공은 <<<image_2>>>의 초코색 토이푸들. 곱슬털과 갈색 코, 작은 금색 방울 하나가 달린 아이보리 리본을 그대로 살린다.
화면 오른쪽은 <<<image_3>>>의 세이블 포메라니안. 주황빛 털과 크림색 가슴털, 쫑긋 선 귀, 짙은 초록색 체크 리본을 그대로 살린다.

가운데 토이푸들만 양옆 강아지보다 반 발짝 앞에 선다. 셋의 간격을 살짝 띄워 앞발을 들어도 서로의 얼굴이나 리본을 가리지 않게 한다. 처음부터 끝까지 각자의 자리, 얼굴, 털색, 리본을 유지한다.

세 마리는 원본 속 각자 위치의 안무를 같은 박자로 따라 춘다. 앞발을 들어 움직이는 방향, 몸을 기울이는 각도, 셋이 동시에 고개를 꾸벅 숙였다가 드는 순간까지 원본에 맞춘다. 뒷발로 서서 춤출 때도 실제 소형견의 체구와 다리 길이를 유지한다. 앞발과 뒷발은 끝까지 털로 덮인 강아지 발 모양이다.

마지막 박자에 양옆 두 마리는 원본의 마무리 자세를 유지한다. 가운데 토이푸들만 카메라를 보며 한쪽 앞발을 가볍게 한 번 흔들어 인사한다. 그 움직임에 아이보리 리본 아래 금색 방울이 살짝 흔들린다. 마지막까지 셋의 얼굴과 발끝이 한 화면에 보이게 한다. 추가 대사와 자막 없이 원본 오디오로 끝낸다.

items.title: Seoul Shih Tzu Stroll
items.description: A giant Shih Tzu follows running pedestrians through Seoul streets before appearing in helicopter views and licking a skyscraper window.

variants.prompt:
Recreate <<<video_1>>> as an ultra-photorealistic video set around the 63 Building in Yeouido, Seoul, replacing the original dog with the exact Shih Tzu shown in <<<image_4>>>.

REFERENCE PRIORITY
<<<video_1>>> controls the original motion, action timing, camera movement, framing, shot order, cut timing, and helicopter movement.
<<<image_1>>> controls the environment and Korean runners in the FIRST shot.
<<<image_2>>> controls the environment and helicopter-window composition in the SECOND shot.
<<<image_3>>> controls the environment and low-angle composition in the THIRD shot.
<<<image_4>>> exclusively controls the dog's identity, anatomy, proportions, and fur markings.

Preserve the original duration and vertical 9:16 framing. Keep exactly three shots with the original cuts. Use the original cut points rather than forcing the approximate time ranges below. Animate each scene naturally; do not create a slideshow or transitions between still photographs.

DOG IDENTITY — ALL THREE SHOTS
Completely replace the original dog with ONE identical black-and-white Shih Tzu from <<<image_4>>>. Preserve its round dark eyes, short muzzle, small black nose, white forehead blaze, exact dark facial patches, soft black floppy ears, fluffy white chest, short legs, compact torso, natural paws, and curled fluffy tail.

Enlarge this exact dog to the original video's colossal scale while retaining its reference proportions. Transfer the original movements onto the Shih Tzu's anatomy without stretching its legs, narrowing its face, lengthening its muzzle, or changing its breed.

No original dog's face, upright ears, wiry beard, pearl necklace, pendant, or other accessories. No clothing. Maintain the same identity, fur pattern, and physical scale across every cut.

The scene photographs are background references. Their lack of a dog must NOT remove the dog from the finished video. Insert and animate the replacement Shih Tzu in ALL THREE SHOTS.

SHOT 1 — STREET VIEW, approximately 0–4 seconds
Use <<<image_1>>> as the environment and composition reference. Preserve the golden 63 Building, surrounding Seoul offices, road, sidewalk, Korean vehicles, and daytime lighting.

Place the giant Shih Tzu in the original dog's position behind the running people. Match its approach, steps, paw movements, head motion, and screen occupancy to <<<video_1>>>.

Animate exactly SIX Korean adults from <<<image_1>>>: four men and two women. Preserve their faces, clothing, relative positions, and three-front/three-behind arrangement. They run toward the camera with the original video's urgency, stride timing, and arm movements. These six replace the original foreground runners; do not add a second group or duplicate anyone.

Preserve the source camera retreat and handheld movement, with natural foot contact, perspective, occlusion, and shadows.

SHOT 2 — HELICOPTER WINDOW, approximately 4–7 seconds
Use <<<image_2>>> as the environment reference. Preserve the close helicopter window frame, interior edges, tilted aerial composition, and nearby golden 63 Building facade.

Reproduce the source helicopter camera movement and parallax. Place the same giant Shih Tzu outside, partially occluded by the building exactly as the original dog is. Match the timing of its face appearing, head movement, gaze, and relative scale. The dog remains grounded in the city below, never floating beside the window.

Retain the external helicopter action from <<<video_1>>> even though the background photograph does not contain it.

SHOT 3 — EXTREME LOW ANGLE, approximately 7 seconds to the end
Use <<<image_3>>> as the environment reference. Preserve the steep upward camera angle, massive golden facade on the left, narrow street foreground, and surrounding Seoul buildings.

Reproduce the original dog's head turn, muzzle contact with the glass, and licking action at the same moments, using the reference Shih Tzu's short muzzle and natural tongue.

Restore the dog's reflection in the golden glass. The reflection must depict this SAME replacement Shih Tzu and precisely follow its movement, contact, and perspective. It is a reflection, not a second dog.

Preserve the original helicopters' number, flight paths, timing, and overhead positions.

REALISM AND CONTINUITY
Maintain consistent daylight, gold glass reflections, realistic fur, natural motion blur, grounded contact shadows, and believable giant scale. Keep the architecture stable during camera movement. Reconstruct occluded surfaces naturally.

No Manhattan buildings, New York taxis, breed changes, identity drift, extra dogs, duplicated people, extra limbs, floating paws, warped architecture, flickering fur, mismatched reflections, added destruction, extra cuts, slow motion, subtitles, captions, or watermark.

variants.prompt:
세로 9:16, 약 15초. 원본 영상에서 DJ 믹서와 프라이팬을 오가는 주인공만 <<<image_1>>>의 할머니로 교체한다. 얼굴, 자연스러운 주름, 짧은 흰머리는 <<<image_1>>>을 따른다. 의상은 <<<image_2>>>의 코발트블루 반팔, 흑백 체크 앞치마, 짙은 회색 바지와 검은 슬립온을 입힌다. 주방 배경과 조명은 원본 영상을 따른다.

원본 인물의 손동작과 리듬을 그대로 따라 한다. 어느 손으로 믹서 버튼을 누르는지, 언제 몸을 돌려 팬을 잡는지, 시선이 어디로 향하는지 원본과 맞춘다. 믹서를 다룰 때는 비트에 맞춰 어깨를 살짝 들썩이며 능숙한 표정을 짓는다. 음식 접시, DJ 믹서, 가스레인지, 프라이팬은 원래 위치에 두고 손가락이 버튼과 팬 손잡이에 자연스럽게 닿게 한다.
